requirements: Exact device IRQ20/vector36/CAN1_RX0_IRQHandler; reject already enabled or active line ownership. Four implemented priority bits; priority5 policy gives IP[20]=0x50.
Keep global interrupts masked and the source/line disabled while installing handler/state. Literal bank0 bit20 actions only, not RMW.
Clear peripheral cause before ICPR[0] bit20. Enable source and line only through the dependent CAN IRQ workflow after initialization; restore intended global state last.

requirements: Exact device TIM5_IRQn50, vector slot66; NVIC bank1 bit18 and IP[50]. Four implemented priority bits; write encoded0x20 for logical priority2.

Fresh exclusive startup with global mask1; inspect implemented external NVIC banks0..2 and reject any enabled/pending/active line, including TIM5. Highest device IRQ FPU_IRQn81 gives three banks. Preserve every unrelated line/priority byte.
Use literal write-one ISER/ICER/ICPR actions, never read-modify-write. ICPR does not clear active state.
Handler/vector and state ready first. Prepare/read back priority and clear pending only after source is disabled; enable/read back line while capture request remains disabled.
Enable/read back capture request before PWM output, enable PWM counter last, then unmask global interrupts with fences. No unrelated interrupt source is active.
On terminal outcome disable capture request before disabling/clearing line, mask globally in Thread, require no pending/active/enabled state; inaccessible/failed cleanup cannot claim quiet.

requirements: Fresh privileged Thread startup, PRIMASK=1, exclusive ownership of TIM2/TIM5 and GPIOA pins1/2; no downstream TRGO consumers during UG and no live clock/configuration changes.
Actual ready HSI selected, nominal16MHz, AHB/APB1/APB2 all divisor1 and SystemCoreClock synchronized; PSC=15 produces nominal1MHz ticks.
Configure/read back with channels and CEN disabled; UG transfers preloads and can emit TRGO even when MMS=0; clear stale status only during owned disabled setup.
No IRQ/DMA, slave/encoder/external-reset, center-aligned, advanced-timer or other instance support implied. All accesses are full32-bit words; failure latches and never automatically retries.
CC3S=01 direct TI3; IC3PSC=IC3F=0, CC3P=CC3NP=0, ARR=0xFFFFFFFF, ARPE=0, SMS=ECE=0, DIER=0; enable/read back capture before PWM output.
The counter free-runs independently of TIM2 ARR; read the entire32-bit CCR3 word, never write it. CCR3 input read clears CC3IF.
Bound polling; reject CC3OF both before and after data read, or a new CC3IF after read; never publish ambiguous data.
Discard enable edge and prime a natural PWM edge, then accept8 successive unsigned32-bit periods1000+/-2 local ticks; this is not independent oscillator calibration.
Missing jumper, wrong period, ownership/configuration/clock changes, overflow races or failed shutdown latch failure; restart requires explicit reset.
capture_ch3_pa2.title: TIM5 CH3 rising direct input on PA2 AF2

requirements: Fresh privileged Thread/MSP startup with PRIMASK1, BASEPRI=FAULTMASK0; only exact paired TIM2/TIM5 route, no downstream UG/TRGO consumers or live owner/clock changes.
Prepare/read back complete counters/fields with CEN, channels and DIER disabled; full32-bit capture words, read-only CCR3. Never poll/drain CCR3 in Thread after arming IRQ.
Start capture channel/counter first, prepare/read back NVIC line/priority, set DIER=CC3IE only, enable PWM output/counter last, unmask globally after state/vector are ready.
ISR must see IPSR66 and expected live clock/pin/register state. Read SR then CCR3 once then SR; reject absent cause, overcapture or a new capture flag after the data read.
Discard initial output-enable edge, store9 natural timestamps and validate8 unsigned32-bit intervals1000+/-2 ticks. Success needs10 exception receipts and10 data reads.
Terminal ISR disables request before line/pending clear; Thread masks globally and verifies pending/active/enabled zero, then stops owned timers/releases pins. Failure latches, no retry.
Bound Thread waiting by iterations. Distinguish a no-stored-edge timeout from pending captures without ISR delivery. No DMA, nesting, other timer modes or physical IRQ acceptance.
capture_ch3_pa2_irq.title: TIM5 CH3 direct rising capture through IRQ50

requirements: Exclusive fresh TIM2, no channel/slave/interrupt/DMA owners, declared HSE8 PLL mode and APB1/4; TIM2CLK=2*PCLK1=84 MHz.
Keep CEN=0 and DIER=0 while setting PSC=8399, ARR=9. Write EGR=UG to load PSC/reinitialize counter; write SR=0 afterward to discard the UG-created UIF.
Set CR1=OPM|CEN with UDIS/URS/DIR/CMS/ARPE zero. Poll UIF with a finite budget and verify CEN cleared. This is 1 ms nominal under the declared clock assumptions, not measured timing.
Do not accept the stale UG flag as elapsed time. Stop the owned timer on failure. This operation uses no timer output pin or NVIC interrupt.
polling_update_delay.title: Owned TIM2 one-pulse polling delay at TIM2CLK=84 MHz

requirements: Fresh privileged owned startup, PRIMASK=1, no downstream TRGO consumers; TIM1 stays gated.
Checked nominal HSI16/APB1 divisor1; PSC<=65535, period2..UINT32_MAX counts, high0..period.
CC1S=CC2S=0, OC1M=110, OC1PE=1, ARPE=1; all CCER enables and DIER requests remain0.
Configure while CEN=0; verify CCMR1 direction before CCR1 write; UG transfers preloads, clear stale SR, verify, enable CEN last.
CCR1 readback is preload only; wait for a fresh bounded UIF event for update evidence; no compare-event guarantee.
No GPIO/pin waveform, advanced/center/toggle modes, DMA or IRQ support is implied; failure/cleanup never permits automatic retry.
pwm_ch1_reference.title: TIM2 internal PWM1 channel1 reference; physical output disabled

requirements: Fresh checked HSI16/divisors1, exclusive TIM2/TIM5/pin ownership, no downstream UG/TRGO consumers. Configure under global mask; only the final interrupt-ready paired step may unmask.
TIM2 PSC15/ARR999/CCR2=250, PWM1/OC2PE/ARPE, direction up/edge-aligned. TIM2 DIER remains0, all other channels disabled; TIM5 alone requests IRQ50.
Use complete GPIO AF1 PA1/AF2 PA2 route and verify output direction before CCR2 write. Prepare counters/preloads/stale flags before IRQ arming; capture/line/request ready before final output and CEN.

Only the paired capture_irq contract supplies exception receipts and cleanup. On failure mask requests/line, quiesce owned timers/pins and report incomplete shutdown explicitly. No DMA or other timer instance support.
pwm_ch2_irq_pair.title: TIM2 CH2 PWM paired with TIM5 capture interrupt

requirements: Fresh privileged Thread startup, PRIMASK=1, exclusive ownership of TIM2/TIM5 and GPIOA pins1/2; no downstream TRGO consumers during UG and no live clock/configuration changes.
Actual ready HSI selected, nominal16MHz, AHB/APB1/APB2 all divisor1 and SystemCoreClock synchronized; PSC=15 produces nominal1MHz ticks.
Configure/read back with channels and CEN disabled; UG transfers preloads and can emit TRGO even when MMS=0; clear stale status only during owned disabled setup.
No IRQ/DMA, slave/encoder/external-reset, center-aligned, advanced-timer or other instance support implied. All accesses are full32-bit words; failure latches and never automatically retries.
CC2S=CC1S=0, OC2M=110 PWM1, OC2PE=1, ARPE=1, DIR=CMS=0; PSC15/ARR999/CCR2=250 gives nominal1kHz/25% output.
Verify CCMR1 output direction before CCR2 write; keep all other channels disabled and DIER=0.
Start TIM5 capture timer/channel and verify first, then enable/read back CC2E and enable/read back TIM2 CEN last. Discard the initial output-enable edge.
On failure stop owned output/counters and release only the two GPIO pins; inaccessible clocks or failed readback cannot claim quiet shutdown.
pwm_ch2_pa1.title: TIM2 CH2 PWM1 on PA1 AF1

requirements: Fresh privileged owned startup, PRIMASK=1, no downstream TRGO consumers; TIM1 gate remains0.
CC1S=11, TS=000 selects TIM1_TRGO/ITR0; SMS=0/ECE=0; IC1PSC=0, IC1F=0, CC1P=CC1NP=0.
Keep CEN=0, ARR=0xFFFFFFFF, DIER=0; enable CC1E only after UG, stale clearing and validated setup.
Refuse pending CC1IF/CC1OF before issuing an event; write/read back stopped CNT, then action-write EGR.CC1G.
Bound polling; read CCR1 before final SR overcapture/new-event check; reject stale, missing, overcaptured or mismatching data.
Never write CCR1 in input mode. No external pin, elapsed-time, filter or edge measurement is qualified.
